test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct option that indicates the correct arrangement of the following human body parts from top to bottom.

1. Waist

2. Neck

3. Legs

4. Chest

5. Eyes
solution:
This sequence represents the vertical arrangement of human body parts from top to bottom.

5. Eyes (Located at the top of the body)

2. Neck (Connects the head to the torso)

4. Chest (Located in the upper torso region)

1. Waist (The narrowest part of the torso, above the hips)

3. Legs (Located at the bottom of the body)

Hence, "5, 2, 4, 1, 3" is the correct answer.
